recordEncoding.mappingGap: records.mappings[i] = [gapCodes, readinessTags, objectGroupIndexes]; every record inherits authoritativeStatus UNRESOLVED and root sourceChecklistProfile status SOURCE EVIDENCE INCOMPLETE; mapping ID and record ID derive from inventory.mappingIds[i] as mapping:<id>
recordEncoding.additionalOperationGap: records.additionalOperations[i] = [gapCodes, readinessTags, objectGroupIndexes]; every record inherits authoritativeStatus UNRESOLVED and root sourceChecklistProfile status SOURCE EVIDENCE INCOMPLETE; ID derives from inventory.additionalOperationIds[i] as additional-operation:<id>
recordEncoding.gapId: Each individual gap ID is gap:<derived record ID>:<gapCode>. Every record has the global source checklist profile and production evidence profile below.

gapCatalog.semantic-transition: Source/canonical presence does not prove semantic equivalence or historic transition.
gapCatalog.production-state: No production database was accessed; actual state is UNKNOWN.
gapCatalog.operational-recovery: Lock, timeout, transaction, partial failure, retry and recovery require evidence.
gapCatalog.dependency-order: Source-declared dependency/order requires semantic review, including cross-owner effects.
gapCatalog.business-decision: Destructive/data-changing or replacement effect requires approved business decision and owner.
